pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any raw fish. Starts Active + Wait; cooked fish does not work.

Raw cod, salmon, tropical fish, and pufferfish work. Its cat head marks the profession. While active, nearby creepers use the same six-block avoidance goal used for cats. Activation and movement are independent: Active/Inactive does not change Wait/Roam, and changing movement does not change activation.
It retains normal companion stats, naming, dyeing, healing, ownership, and recovery. It has no bag or equipment. Native avoidance is not a guarantee against a creeper that has already ignited.
